scope: BetaNYC recurring newsletter freshness, privacy-safe normalization, official-destination verification, cross-source deduplication, strong-match admission, and modeled-reader cost control
gateOrder: newest authenticated edition and public-archive reconciliation
recipient tracking and private mailbox data removal
clean employer destination and live-posting verification
compensation, eligibility, expiration, and specialist hard screens
fit, securability, and combined strong-match thresholds
requiredInvariants: No raw email, recipient address, mailbox identifier, unsubscribe link, or recipient-specific tracking token is committed.
The newest mailbox edition may lead the public archive without being falsely described as publicly archived.
The newsletter is discovery and editorial provenance; the employer posting governs role facts.
An opportunity already admitted from another source is enriched, not duplicated.
Excluded and below-threshold leads do not receive modeled-reader calls.
No score establishes eligibility, interview, offer, or hire.
costControl: Freshness, privacy, destination, eligibility, compensation, expiration, specialist, threshold, and deduplication checks precede modeled-reader work.

execution.passStatement: I would interview this person for this specific role and see a credible path to hiring, subject to ordinary verification.
execution.authorityBoundary: A modeled reader is a synthetic public-context lens, not the real person's participation, opinion, endorsement, or hiring decision.
